t: This fixed GU10 / GU5.3 downlight converter is designed to replace older incandescent downlights, effectively covering large apertures up to 140mm. It is suitable for domestic and commercial indoor installations, such as kitchens, hallways, or office spaces. The converter features a durable steel body and a gloss white bezel, offering a clean finish. It includes both GU10 and GU5.3 lampholders, providing flexibility for various bulb types. Operating on a 220-240V mains and battery-powered supply, it accommodates a maximum 50W bulb. Fixings are supplied for straightforward installation, and a transformer is required.
b: Replaces Older Incandescent Downlights & Covers Large Apertures
Includes GU10 & GU5.3 Lampholders for Versatility
Fixed Design Ensures Simple & Secure Installation
Fixings Supplied for Convenient & Quick Setup
